seo.description: Cala Bonita in Al Hoceima: a compact Mediterranean cove for swimming, photos and a quieter alternative to Quemado.

name: Cala Bonita
hero_subtitle: A sheltered cove near town — clear water and a classic Al Hoceima swimming stop.

overview.title: Small cove, big reputation
overview.p1: Cala Bonita is one of the names visitors hear first: a compact, sheltered cove with clear water and a postcard feel without leaving the Al Hoceima area.
overview.p2: It is popular in high season, so early arrival helps. The setting is more intimate than Quemado’s wide bay.
overview.p3: Bring water and expect limited shade. Combine with a town afternoon if you only want a short cove session.

q1.question: How busy is it?
q1.answer: Can be busy in summer afternoons — mornings are calmer.

q2.question: Good for families?
q2.answer: Sheltered water appeals to many families; supervise children as with any cove.

q3.question: Parking / access?
q3.answer: Access is local-road based; taxis know the stop.

q4.question: Snorkelling?
q4.answer: Clear water helps on calm days; no formal dive centre on the sand.

q5.question: Nearby alternatives?
q5.answer: Quemado for a wider beach; Sfiha for soft sand further along.
